Who are the powers supporting the Young Wolves? What gifts will they give? This is outlined in this note to help clarify being, location, gift, gift location, and trial/ quest.

**GODS:** The Gods Kronos and Telura are supporting the party directly as benefactors of Reister and Ivys respectively.
- Kronos: Directed Reister to find *[Oztar](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/UDPz9EiTgk5x)* in order to be reborn as a demigod. Oztar requires a potent ritual and is a process to remake Reister into a Demi-God imbued with the power of the ancient hero and son of Fulgrim, Giesor. [[Oztar, Heart of the Demi-God]], Oztar is held within Chronovault Mythos in the Great Divide.
- **IVYS OPTIONS**:
	- Main thing is that he has to find a scroll of Blade of Disaster, and cast that to summon TOWC. This can be found in Arkonia, specifically in two places: The Drowning Dream Swamp, or Moonshadow Academy.
	- Telura: The One who Casts holds the secret of who gave mortals the ability to use arcane magic, making them independent of the gods to survive in Terra-Nova. In order to get Telura's boon (some badass magical item, maybe a high level spell scroll) Ivys has to give that secret to Telura and help her remove the study of arcane magic, returning to the need for divinity.
	- The One Who Casts: The One Who Casts is the embodiment of magic. He is a spirit born from the essence of the weave, he has a childlike mind and is very curious. His conversation with Ivys will essentially be about how he can't save Ivys, but he will reveal Ivys' true nature, saying he isn't dying because he hasn't returned to Kairos, but because his original, Kairos's daughter Lisa, is dead. Without her he can't exist. TOWC will tell Ivys to seek out the Iron mage, another replicant who has solved their deterioration in the Chronovault Mythos, or to go for demonic rebirth, reforging grants him life forever, but no power, demonic rebirth grants power but a normal life span.
	- Karegor: Karegor is the hunger for learning. He will give Ivys an artificially preserved life and some valuable items in exchange for the secret of TOWC. He wants Ivys to never stop seeking, and he will demand Ivys to steal and commit evil acts in his name with he end goal of gaining knowledge. He wants Ivys first to give up his position as the White Wizard, and install Karegor as the Lord of Learning in Terra-Nova. He wants to know everything and take whatever he pleases.
	- Demonic Rebirth: 


**PRIME CREATIONS:** The prime creations are guardians of Terra-Nova, and while they cannot defeat Arkonil alone, by giving their power to the Young Wolves they can stop the calamity.
- **Fyrnanth** the Crystal Dragon: Fyrnanth is the oldest dragon, and has a unique love for travel, knowledge, and portals. His horde is beneath the celestial gate on the White Desert Isle, and it contains many portals to other dimensions and worlds. Located on the White Desert Isle beneath the last Celestial Gate.
	- McGuffin: 
	- *[Pandora](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/VVqTp_9iqEEQ)*, The Crystal Halo *(Antigone/Ryfon)*
- **Aurathia** the Golden Naiad: Auria is known widely as the "Lady of the Lake", whom has been the subject of myths and legends throughout the Dreadlands and Berserker Peaks for millennia.  Located in Lake Irath.
	- McGuffin: 
	- *[Lightpiercer](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/f-Z_w4UZ_rdr)*, The Lance of Aethos *(Emrys)*
- **Sylvaris** the Tree Father: The first Ent and tree spirit, father and guardian of nature. Located in the Caves of Seline Thrimai.
	- McGuffin: Thornebinder, The Veins of Tena
	- *[Rootsunder](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/o-_jWKCukhyz)*, The Heartwood Axe *(Fargrim)*
- **Tiurah** the Last Comet: The spirit of the comet that birthed Sozin. Combines the power of wild space elementals, a formless being of pure energy of the forces that make up the universe. You need to unite Sozin (fire), Aeros (air), Nepturi (water), and Umbervos (earth). Umbervos resides in "The Caves of Seline Thrimai" with Sylvaris, and Nepturi is with Aurathia. Aethos is currently allied with Stygian against its will, and Sozin is staying with [[Lorne]] in the Sword on the Wall Tavern
	- McGuffin: 
	- *[Celestia](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/rPvdRmt21K6z)*, The Stardust Mantle *(Ivys)*
